learning_outcomes.text: Comprehend electric charge and electrification phenomena.
Analyze force, electric field, etc., created by charged systems.
Learn electric field and its applications.
Learn and apply Gauss's law and the concept of flux.
Learn the concept of electric potential and its applications.
Know the areas of use of capacitors in technology and design capacitor circuits.
Gain knowledge about resistance and resistive circuits.
Gain knowledge on electric circuits, current, voltage, and power.
Apply electromagnetic induction, Faraday's and Lenz's laws in electrical circuits.
Comprehend the formation of magnetic field and magnetic field force.
Analyze alternating current and its circuits.

syllabus_topics: Capacitance and Capacitors, Properties of Dielectrics
Alternating Current Circuits (RL and RC Circuits)
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
